newsitem.title: EGYPT: Italian defence minister in talks in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Italian defence minister in talks in Egypt.

text.p: Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa held talks on Saturday with Italy's Defence Minister Beniamino Andreatta on ways to strengthen ties between the two countries.
Moussa said his talks with Andreatta included regional and international issues of interest to Egypt and Italy, which wants a greater role in the Middle East peace process.
Andreatta arrived in Cairo on Friday to hold talks with Egyptian officials and attend memorial services marking the anniversary of the 1942 Battle of el-Alamein.

Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi is due to fly to Cairo on Sunday for talks with President Hosni Mubarak. It will be his first visit to the Middle East since he was appointed prime minister in May.
